name: Vaaya
description: Call paid services through Vaaya with one API key, or pay per call with no account. This specification covers the actions sold keyless: fixed-price actions over x402 (USDC on Base) and, where listed, MPP (Tempo charge, USDC.e), plus the MPP-only Hotel Lobby video job. Use GET /api/run for all actions, including free and variable-price services. Read the schema guide at https://vaaya.ai/docs/reference/openapi.
